title: trochocephalus lyratus
intro: Trochocephalus lyratus, commonly known as the 'Bleeding Heart' or 'Coral Bells', is a type of flowering plant in the Saxifragaceae family. It is known for its heart-shaped flowers that dangle from its foliage, giving it a unique and striking appearance. The health benefits of Trochocephalus lyratus include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may exert anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
